'If Evergreen is played from arsenal, put it on the bottom of its owner's deck when the combat chain closes.' Earth Action - Attack (Oldhim blitz deck).

TIMING VERIFIED END TO END: ON_COMBAT_CLOSE is a mapped trigger (trigger_types.py:82); engine._dsl_combat_close_listener (engine.py:1620-1627) dispatches it to combat.attack_card WHILE COMBAT STILL EXISTS, and _close_step emits 'combat_chain_close' at CR 7.7.3 (engine.py:779) BEFORE _close_combat_chain (7.7.5-6, engine.py:786) moves the attack to the graveyard - so the ability resolves while Evergreen is still the attack card on the chain.

PLAYED_FROM_ARSENAL (condition_types.py:789-809) reads card.played_from_zone, which play.py stamps at the moment of play (play.py:1120-1126) and which survives the arsenal -> chain move; prev_zone is the fallback. True exactly when this copy was played from arsenal, per the printed 'If Evergreen is played from arsenal'. SOURCE_IS_ATTACK matches the shipped spelling pattern for close-step triggers on attack cards (evr/swing_big_red.json) and is true at dispatch by construction.

PUT_SELF_BOTTOM_DECK (effect_types.py:1618-1639) moves THIS card via put_object with position None = append = bottom of the controller's deck (controller == owner here; no control-change effects involved). The chain-close interaction is the documented Herald-of-Protection path (engine.py:2229-2243): put_object cannot resolve the game-level combat-chain zone, so the card is added to the deck without a double-remove; _close_combat_chain then sees zone != chain name (relocated), drops the stale chain membership, and skips the graveyard - no duplication, card ends on deck bottom exactly once.

NOT OPTIONAL per official release note 1 ('the effect is not optional'): the PUT_SELF_BOTTOM_DECK handler reads no optional parameter and is mandatory by default - correct as authored.
